payload.message: Now I am removing the support. New problem, same underlying idea, different surface.

payload.text:
I’d first calculate how many books are lost during the year. 10% of 800 = 0.10 × 800 = 80 books lost.

That leaves 800 − 80 = 720 books remaining.

Next, I’d calculate how many of those 720 books are placed on the special display. 30% of 720 = 0.30 × 720 = 216 books on display.

So there are 720 − 216 = 504 books that are not on display.

Finally, I’d calculate 20% of those 504 books for repair. 0.20 × 504 = 100.8 books.

That gives 504 − 100.8 = 403.2 books not chosen for repair.
